commitResults.messageBody: Save the task list after each successful mutation and restore it at startup using a relative, cross-platform data path. Handle missing directories and malformed saved records without crashing the chatbot, and isolate UI test cases from generated data.
Require ISO-8601 dates for deadlines and events, store them as LocalDate values, and display them in a readable format. Persist dates in ISO form and add UI coverage for valid and invalid date input.
Extract user interaction, command parsing, and task list responsibilities from Aether. Move sources into the aether package while preserving storage rollback behaviour.
Separate task, parser, storage, user interface, and exception classes into focused packages while keeping src/main/java as the source root.
Add the Gradle Wrapper and configure Java 25 builds to run the Aether application.
Test command parsing, task-list operations, and task storage to catch invalid input and persistence errors.
Configure the Shadow JAR manifest and document how to build and run the distributable.
Indent switch cases consistently, document intentional fall-through, and use American spelling in JavaDoc.
Let users find tasks by a case-insensitive description keyword, reject empty searches safely, and cover the behavior in unit and UI tests.

commitResults.messageBody: Disable persistence after a startup load failure so an empty recovery list cannot overwrite unreadable data. Keep search results aligned with full-list task numbers and exit the CLI cleanly on end-of-input. Add regression coverage for all three cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Prevent data loss after failed loading
commitResults.messageBody: Keep the recovered task list read-only when saved data cannot be loaded, and exit console sessions cleanly when standard input ends.
